purpose: Bound dotfiles flake source without copying runtime workspace data
contract: Use the shared Engine loader and a repository-specific tracked hidden-input policy on cold entry
failureBoundary: A missing or invalid loader or policy fails closed before flake evaluation
evidence: Tiny tracked Git fixture exercises hidden policy; entrypoint stub tests ordering and failure propagation; uncached direnv reads projected path; flake check --no-build evaluates projected source.
falsifier: A runtime sentinel enters filtered source, a required tracked input is absent, or cold entry evaluates the bare checkout
nonGoals: Changing the shared Engine filter implementation
invariants: Ordinary visible untracked source remains included subject to existing exclusions

assumptions.claim: Cold shell entry has access to the Engine organizational Nix config and Forgejo SSH for the pinned helper
assumptions.falsifier: The config root is unavailable or Forgejo SSH cannot fetch the pinned revision

assumptions.claim: Engine PR #1761 commit 89abff9f058a543aa9597f20007a9b0ee6673db6 remains fetchable and is integrated before this consumer is merged
assumptions.falsifier: Forgejo no longer serves that commit or the prerequisite PR is not integrated

baseline.command: nix --extra-experimental-features "nix-command flakes" flake metadata --json --no-write-lock-file path:<fixture>; test -f <reported-path>/.worktrees/sentinel
baseline.result: RED: bare path source copied runtime sentinel
